description: List of donations received arranged according to parshiyot and possibly some commercial accounts (given the mention of shops). Dating: late 18th- or early 19th-century based on the paleography. This fragment may have once belonged to a single ledger comprised of other shelfmarks in the AIU.VII.F series. Requires further examination.
description_he: רשימת תרומות שהתקבלו, מסודרת לפי פרשיות.
